speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since there is no fever or cough, I need to clarify if there is any abdominal pain, jaundice, or if you have noticed any bruising or petechiae on your child's skin. Also, please tell me if your child has been experiencing excessive thirst or frequent urination.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely viral). The combination of rapid breathing, significant liver enlargement (hepatomegaly), pitting edema, diminished appetite, and absence of fever or respiratory infection signs strongly suggests acute liver failure or severe hepatitis rather than cardiac or pulmonary causes.
